DEVELOPMENT CASE STUDY / 05

Modernising a live despatch application

OrganisationDHL / UK Mail
Project datesMay – July 2017
RoleContract full-stack developer

THE WORK

Interface improvements, product reporting and an automated release pipeline for an established logistics application.

Historical software development experience.

The requirement

iConsign needed interface improvements and better access to product performance information. Its build and release process also presented risks that needed attention.

Our contribution

We modernised the interface with Bootstrap and introduced a Power BI dashboard. We identified weaknesses in the build and release process, demonstrated alternatives and created an automated release pipeline.

What was delivered

An updated interface, a dashboard for accessing product KPIs and a revised delivery process. The CV records that the release-process changes were adopted across the online team.

Why this experience matters

Modernisation includes how software is built and released as well as what users see. This project shows practical work on both sides of that responsibility.
